subject: AP: e-invoice (UBL) + mandatory header fields for Redwood invoices
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novaforge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Integrations <aptech@novaforge.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: AP: e-invoice (UBL) and invoice header requirements

Hi Jonas —

We're starting vendor setup for Redwood before we can route POs. Our AP team requires the following before we create a supplier record and enable payment routing: 

1) A sample machine-readable e-invoice in UBL 2.1 (XML) that matches the invoice fields you will send. We need the invoice <cbc:ID> to contain the customer's PO number and <cbc:InvoiceTypeCode> set.
2) Invoice header must include: legal name, trading name (if different), VAT number, company registration number, registered address, and the bank account IBAN and BIC in a separate remittance block.
3) PDF + XML pair for each invoice (we store both).
4) A scanned VAT registration certificate for the entity that will issue invoices to Novaforge.
5) Signed bank mandate or confirmation from your bank for SEPA/ACH payments.
6) Preferred payment terms (we default to Net 30) and whether Redwood accepts PO-numbered invoices or requires the PO line mapping.

Please send the documents and a point of contact for our vendor verification team. We plan to finish setup within 5 business days of receiving complete artifacts.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of AP Operations — Novaforge Systems

--
Attachment stubs: vendor_requirements_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novaforge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AP: e-invoice (UBL) and invoice header requirements

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Attaching the vendor packet and a sample UBL 2.1 invoice (XML + PDF) that mirrors how our billing system will emit invoices to customers. Quick answers below to your checklist:

- PO placement: we will populate <cbc:ID> with the Novaforge PO value and include the PO as a top-level reference and in each invoice line's additionalReference element.
- VAT certificate: attached (redwood-vat-certificate.pdf).
- Bank mandate: attached sample (bank-mandate-sample.pdf). We can sign via DocuSign if you prefer.
- Payment terms: standard Redwood hosted billing is Net 30, but we can accept customer PO-based terms if contract specifies different terms per PO.

Neha — can you confirm the IBAN we should include on the UBL sample (we used GB33BUKB20201555555555 as a placeholder) and confirm whether we need to send a signed SEPA mandate or a bank-signed confirmation letter for SEPA?

Elena — attaching: redwood-vendor-packet.pdf, sample-invoice-UBL-2.1.xml, redwood-vat-certificate.pdf, bank-mandate-sample.pdf. Let me know if you need the sample in CII/UBL variations or as an EDI 810 equivalent.

Best,
Jonas Weber

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AP: e-invoice (UBL) and invoice header requirements

Jonas —

Reviewed the attachments. A few finance items to lock before we finalize the packet to Novaforge: 

1) Legal invoicing entity: confirm whether invoices to Novaforge will be issued by Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) or Redwood Inference EU Ltd (UK/EU entity). VAT certificate attached in the packet is for Redwood Inference EU Ltd — if Novaforge requires a US entity, we'll need to supply W-8/W-9 accordingly.
2) IBAN placeholder: replace the placeholder IBAN with the operative IBAN for EU collections: IE29AIBK93115212345678 (this is a Redwood test IBAN). Also include BIC: AIBKIE2D.
3) UBL specifics: ensure UBL <cac:AccountingSupplierParty>/<cac:PartyIdentification> contains your tax scheme with the VAT number as <cbc:ID> and the schemeID attribute set to "VAT". That is what some AP systems look for when auto-parsing.
4) Remittance email: please include invoices@redwood.com as the remittance address in both PDF and XML.

Monica — from a contract perspective, confirm whether our PO acceptance clause requires a written acceptance for PO amounts over $50k — if so, flag in the vendor packet.

I'll prepare a signed copy of the SEPA mandate and return it for DocuSign.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

--
Attachment stubs: finance_notes.txt (internal)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novaforge.com>

Cc: AP Integrations <aptech@novaforge.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 07:49:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AP: e-invoice (UBL) and invoice header requirements

Thanks, Jonas and Neha — this is very helpful. A couple of confirmations before we start vendor creation: 

- Legal entity: Novaforge prefers invoices from the EU-registered vendor if VAT is being charged. We'll proceed with Redwood Inference EU Ltd (use the VAT certificate you attached).
- IBAN/BIC: please replace the placeholder with the operative IBAN and attach the signed mandate (we need the signed PDF). DocuSign link is acceptable.
- PO mapping: we will map the customer's PO to <cbc:ID> and also pass PO-line references where available. Your UBL sample looks fine for our parser but our ingestion will reject invoices where VAT is not in the supplier tax scheme or where remittance email is missing.

If you can upload the signed mandate via DocuSign or send back the signed PDF and confirm acceptance of Net 30, we'll kick off the vendor record. Once created we'll send over a Coupa vendor ID and vendor portal link (if your systems support portal-based invoicing). Expect vendor creation within 48 hours of receiving the signed mandate + final XML sample.

Regards,
Elena Rossi
Head of AP Operations — Novaforge Systems
